gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-libertinus-serif: Wide-spaced, bead-on-a-thread lettering with a smooth round bowl. Libertinus Serif follows as a text serif, its curves thinning to hairlines where the heading never does.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-libre-caslon-text: Expressive lettering in Bruno Ace SC holds one uniform line, while Libre Caslon Text leans on a faint pull between heavy verticals and lighter horizontals. One is bold, the other quietly bookish.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-lustria: Bruno Ace SC looks drawn with a drafting pen, one constant nib width tracing every outline across wide, spread-out letters. Lustria brings slight but visible thick-thin shading beneath it.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-maitree: Maitree is a classic serif with medium contrast and no sharp hairlines. Bruno Ace SC above it looks like fixed-nib lettering, so give that heading a generous size and let Maitree stay modest.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-marcellus: Refined glass-tube lettering in Bruno Ace SC is hollow and constant in thickness, spaced like beads. And Marcellus earns its etched, literary look from a modest gap between stems and hairlines; the heading does its best work big and short.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-martel: Distinctive spacing gives Bruno Ace SC its calm, unvarying weight, while Martel, a text serif, makes its crossbars a touch thinner than its stems. Martel's horseshoe-open curves keep a longer page moving smoothly.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-mate: Mate has round letters that look cupped, not clenched, under the beaded spread of Bruno Ace SC. Mate, a text serif, steps softly from heavy to light strokes, so a long stretch of it reads with a gentle give.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-mate-sc: Bruno Ace SC spreads its open, never-thinning letters out like beads on a long thread, with a weight that stays unvarying. Give Mate SC, a classic serif with brush-lifted curve endings, the modest size.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-nanum-myeongjo: Refined and quiet, Nanum Myeongjo shows only slight swell on its bowls. Bruno Ace SC is best at spread-out, expressive lettering without any stroke variation, while the serif handles gentle modulation.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-noto-serif-hk: Bruno Ace SC looks like bent tubing, one gauge throughout. Noto Serif HK, a classic serif, tightens its strokes slightly at curve tops and leaves generous gaps where curves end, so extended reading feels dignified and unhurried.
